newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany's Rexrodt repeats 2.5 pct growth forecast.
newsitem.headline: Germany's Rexrodt repeats 2.5 pct growth forecast.

text.p: German Economics Minister Guenter Rexrodt on Friday repeated Bonn's forecast that the sluggish economy would bounce back with a growth rate of 2.5 percent in 1997.
Such growth "would be a good performance" after a 1.4 percent increase in gross domestic product in 1996, Rexrodt said at the opening of a transportation technology centre.
But unemployment, already at a record four million workers, would not change significantly, despite the recovery, he added.
Rexrodt was scheduled to release a new government report on the economy on January 28.
Details of the report already obtained by Reuters showed economic growth forecast at 2.5 percent, unemployment rising to 11 percent and inflation at 1.5 percent this year.
